name: Quick Shot Mark
description: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight. One friendly unit that used a Rush action may still shoot it once.

name: Unwieldy in melee
description: Strikes last when charging - the charged unit swings first.

name: Unwieldy Debuff
description: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which gets Unwieldy in melee once (next time the effect would apply).

name: No Retreat
description: When a unit where most models have this rule fails a morale test that causes it to be Shaken or Routed, the test counts as passed instead. Then, roll as many dice as the number of wounds it would take to fully destroy it, and for each result of 1-3 the unit takes one wound, which can't be ignored.

name: No Retreat Aura
description: This model and its unit get No Retreat.

name: No Retreat Buff
description: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one friendly unit within 12", which gets No Retreat once (next time the effect would apply).

name: Inquisitorial Agent
description: Once per game, if all models in this unit have this rule, it may be activated even if it had already activated this round (stops being fatigued when activated for the second time). Only up to one third of the units in the army with this rule at the beginning of the game (rounding up) may use it in a single round.
